thread:
alex: Quick check — I'm planning a change to let the policy engine record per-tenant preemptive bindings. idea: reserve soft slots ahead of predicted bursts. sanity check?
priya: Nice. how are you predicting bursts? historical EWMA or a spike detector?
alex: EWMA + spike detector from telemetry. EWMA for baseline, spike detector for sudden lifts. if ewma > threshold -> emit reserve hint.
jamie: Be careful about fairness. soft reservations must be revokeable, otherwise we starve other tenants. :warning:
alex: Agreed. plan is soft reservation with a revoke TTL and a priority score. revokes go through matchmaker, not abrupt kills.
mikhail: Can we express this in the policy DSL? e.g. reserve_if(ewma(route,1m) > 5, slots=2, ttl=30s)
alex: Prototype DSL snippet I hacked together:
```
policy reserve_preemptive {
  when ewma(qps, 1m) > 5
  action reserve(slots=2, ttl=30s, priority=0.6)
}
```
priya: I want a numeric backstop: don't reserve more than 10% of a pool. otherwise noisy tenants will grab too much.
sam: Also add telemetry: reserved_slots, revoked_count, reservation_latency, reservation_rejects. need these in Console dashboards.
alex: Yep, adding telemetry. open question: where do we compute ewma/hints? inside policy engine or in sidecar?
jamie: Prefer sidecar/telemetry to keep policy engine stateless. sidecar emits 'preemptive_hint' with score.
priya: That changes trust model — policy engine must verify hints (recent samples) else a compromised sidecar could request slots.
mikhail: Policy engine should enforce local caps and validate hint freshness/signature. keep a short lookback window.
alex: Migration idea: v1 = sidecar-only hints (permissive), v2 = policy-enforced reservations with caps, auditing, and TTL revokes.
sam: Also add sim tests: simulate 100 tenants with synthetic spikes and confirm 99th p50 SLOs and no tenant starvation. use sim harness to explore worst-case.
alex: I'll draft a follow-up RFC with the math for sliding-window ewma, cap heuristics, and sim results. will attach perf plots. any objections?
jamie: none from me. :+1:
priya: one more thing — we should consider separate warmup_slots for cold model loads so we don't reserve live-serving slots for model load time. different flag.
alex: good call, i'll add warmup_slots flag to the proposal.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: policy-sidecar v0.9 -> canary on 3 hosts at 17:00 UTC.
alex: noted, thanks everyone.
